title: StitchVector 3.0 B2c luminance check: pre-registration (pushed and remote-verified before test seeds 6001-6005 / 6101-6105 are generated)
question: Among the segments B2a adds, does keeping only those whose centre is darker than both sides (dL <= dL_max) remove most fill-edge false lines while keeping most recovered pale ink?

methods.B2a: B0 + additive hysteresis (sv_ld_fix.b2a, c_low 8, add_r 1.5), unchanged
methods.B2c: B0 + only those B2a-added segments with dL <= dL_max, or with unmeasurable sides (stable share < min_stable, kept). B0 geometry never touched; no change to grouping or faces.

threshold_choice: dL_max = -3 is the value stated as the hypothesis (post-hoc, viewed seeds) and was NOT tuned: on the new dev data (phaseA_dev.json) -3 and -4 both met the 80/50 check; -3 was kept as written. Phase A rules were pushed at d6f67ce before the dev data existed.
known_scope_limit: by construction ink that is brighter than one or both sides is deleted (Phase A dev: pale ink on red fill dL +22, mix-colour ink on a red/pink boundary dL +18). This is measured on the test scenes and reported; it decides whether B2c may become a default, not whether the test runs.

metrics.gain: per line type, visible-sample hits added over B0 by B2a and by B2c (sv_ld_compare.score, owner-credited); retained share = B2c added hits / B2a added hits
metrics.false: false length (> 3 px from every truth line) split into fill edge (2.5 px of a fill polygon boundary), band (fill-coloured band + 2 px), other; removed share = 1 - (B2c - B0) / (B2a - B0), per place and total
metrics.segments: B2a-added segments by truth label, kept by B2c, impure segments (largest label share < 0.8)
metrics.non_degradation: B0 length not present in the output (must be 0); mixed cross-line objects; objects
metrics.bands: per band (seed, colour, width): axis share with a line on it, B0 vs B2a vs B2c
metrics.scenes: ink recall per sub-type (dark, pale_darker, boundary_dark, boundary_pale, pale_brighter_than_both_sides, pale_brighter_than_one_side, mix_colour_on_boundary) for B0 / B2a / B2c, and false length by place

reference_targets.note: reference only; adoption also needs: B0 fully kept, boundary ink not clearly worse than B2a, no band worse than B0, images better, no new cross-line objects. Brighter-than-side ink deleted systematically => B2c cannot be the full-map default, whatever the totals.

stop_rule: one run on test seeds, <= 10 min CPU; no code or parameter change after the first number; no B2d
images: per synth test tile: original / B0 / B2a / B2c / B2a added (true vs false) / B2c kept vs deleted; per scene seed one sheet with all scene kinds; local only (pre-push hook)
